mentions.name: Brood
mentions.description: An image editor that treats images as a first-class engineering problem, making opinionated choices about which AI models to use depending on the user's goal. It is themed after StarCraft.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on an images-as-first-class editor that makes opinionated calls on models used depending on your goal (Brood). Sort of like: what would happen if we treated images as an engineering problem.

evidence.value: I'm working on an images-as-first-class editor that makes opinionated calls on models used depending on your goal (Brood). Sort of like: what would happen if we treated images as an engineering problem.
